status: Managed root priorities, palette getter and per-call-version palette/color-key setter contracts are implemented and certified. Original colour-key complex group retains14 cube-attachment traversal failures. Overall original Wine acceptance remains incomplete.
changes: Store the full DWORD priority hint for managed texture roots only. Ordinary textures and non-positive-X/mip subresources reject priority access with INVALIDPARAMS, nontexture getters return INVALIDOBJECT, failed getters preserve output. Setters reject these objects safely, without claiming native crashing setter branches were reproduced or certified. No GPU eviction implemented.

GetPalette clears missing output, AddRefs successful returned palette. SetPalette rejects empty detach with NOPALETTEATTACHED, nonindexed attachment with INVALIDPIXELFORMAT and alpha palettes on nontextures with INVALIDSURFACETYPE before pixel format. Failed setters retain all state and references; replacements AddRef first, publish new binding, then release previous palette.

Palette and colour-key mip restrictions follow the CALL interface version: Surface7 rejects mip sublevels, Surface1/2/3/4 allow them even when the object was created via Surface7. Both setters gain ForVersion engines and actual legacy thunks pass their VERSION; never infer this from factory mode or creation_version. Cube faces at mip zero retain valid setter behavior.
